starting_state: Prepared albumin sol retained inside an intact suspended cellophane cone, cone opening above external distilled-water level and sealed tip submerged. Volumes and membrane dimensions are illustrative, not measured.
scope: Short real-time setup-observation excerpt during dialysis. Source's half-hour wait, water replacement and separate ion-test aliquots are omitted. Molecular diffusion is explanatory content, not visible macroscopic particles.

clips.name: dialysis_observation
clips.action: Hold the camera and dialysis apparatus stationary for a short real-time observation of the intact membrane cone and surrounding water.
clips.state_before: Albumin sol inside the cone; separate clear external water around the intact submerged membrane.
clips.state_after: Colloid remains confined inside the membrane and external water remains visibly clear. No bulk leak, membrane rupture, visible ion particles or completed-purification claim.

prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Photorealistic landscape16:9 laboratory starting reference for dialysis of an albumin sol. Exactly one transparent glass beaker roughly two thirds full of clear colourless external distilled water. A single translucent cellophane membrane cone is suspended inside the water from a simple horizontal support across the beaker rim; the membrane cone's wide OPEN upper mouth is ABOVE the external water surface, and its sealed narrow lower tip is submerged without touching beaker bottom. The intact translucent cone contains a modest amount of faintly opalescent albumin sol, visibly retained INSIDE; surrounding external water stays clear, no bulk mixing. Realistic thin flexible cellophane, gently conical shape with a small tied sealed bottom and visible continuous boundary; suspension clips at upper edges connect to support. Fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera, whole beaker and cone opening visible, beaker60percent frame height, neutral grey clean laboratory bench and background, soft diffuse light. No hands, pour, external reagent test, extra containers, colour-coded particles, arrows, symbols, writing, graduations, numbers, logos or watermark. Illustrative setup only: no visual proof of ion removal, exact volume or elapsed dialysis time.
